description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for publisher actors within an Eclipse Ditto messaging system, managing targets, connection metrics, message publishing, acknowledgements, and related utilities.

classes.name: BasePublisherActor
classes.description: An abstract actor class providing a foundation for message publishers that manage targets, connection metrics, and message dispatching within an Eclipse Ditto environment.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Initializes the actor message handling logic with default and custom message matchers.

methods.name: sendMultiMappedOutboundSignal
methods.description: Handles sending multiple mapped outbound signals, manages response and acknowledgement processing.

methods.name: shouldPublishAcknowledgement
methods.description: Abstract method to determine whether acknowledgements should be published for a given acknowledgement object.

methods.name: issueAcknowledgements
methods.description: Issues acknowledgements back to the sender based on processed responses.

methods.name: sendBackResponses
methods.description: Sends command responses or acknowledgements back to the originating actor.

methods.name: getExceptionConverter
methods.description: Provides a converter for mapping exceptions to acknowledgements; override to customize behavior.

methods.name: aggregateNonNullFutures
methods.description: Utility to aggregate multiple CompletableFutures into a List of results.

methods.name: appendConnectionId
methods.description: Adds the connection ID to acknowledgements.

methods.name: computeMaxAckPayloadBytesForSignal
methods.description: Calculates the maximum payload size for acknowledgements based on configuration.

methods.name: sendMappedOutboundSignal
methods.description: Processes outbound signals, resolves targets, and dispatches messages.

methods.name: getSendingContext
methods.description: Determines the sending context for outbound signals, including reply targets.

methods.name: isResponseOrErrorOrSearchEvent
methods.description: Checks whether an outbound signal is a response, error, or search event.

methods.name: getReplyTargetByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves reply target based on index.

methods.name: getSendingContextForReplyTarget
methods.description: Builds sending context for a reply target.

methods.name: getSendingContextForTarget
methods.description: Builds sending context for a specific target.

methods.name: tryToPublishToGenericTarget
methods.description: Attempts publishing message to a generic target, handles exceptions.

methods.name: publishToGenericTarget
methods.description: Performs actual message publishing to a generic target, applies header mappings, and returns response futures.

methods.name: applyHeaderMapping
methods.description: Applies header mapping to external messages for publishing.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to add message matchers before default.

methods.name: postEnhancement
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to add message matchers after default.

methods.name: toPublishTarget
methods.description: Abstract method to convert an address string into a publish target of type T.

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Abstract method for publishing messages; returns future command response.

methods.name: decodeAsHumanReadable
methods.description: Decodes ByteBuffer into a human-readable string based on message charset.

methods.name: getCharsetFromMessage
methods.description: Determines charset of message content type.

methods.name: escalate
methods.description: Signals a failure to restart by escalating an error.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Retrieves acknowledgement label from a target if available.

methods.name: resolveTargetAddress
methods.description: Resolves a target address string using an expression resolver.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Provides the unique instance identifier.

methods.name: determineCharset
methods.description: Determines charset from a content type string.

methods.name: isTargetAckRequested
methods.description: Checks if acknowledgement is requested for a specific target and message.

methods.name: isLiveSignal
methods.description: Determines whether a signal is considered live, impacting acknowledgement handling.
